text: Stop two, the towers.
Vicity Skyline copies real Miami Beach condos
like the Floridian and Murano Grande.
In 2024, University of Miami scientists
measured buildings along this coast
from Miami Beach to Sunny Isles.
They found 35 towers that had sunk
two to eight centimeters in just seven years.
Local reporters found both of those copied towers
on the list.
In the game, they stand perfectly still.
In real life, they're sinking.
Some Miami buildings are sinking.
One is already gone.
Stop three, the apartment.
GTA 6's two leads, Jason and Lucia,
share a small pink apartment by the bay.
Fans matched it to a real building, the Belmar,
a 1973 condo in Miami's Edgewater.
But in 2022, a developer bought every unit
for about $12 million and tore it down.
Today that spot is an empty lot, so the only place you can still visit the
Belmar is Vice City. And a few streets west, Rockstar copied Miami's walls.
Stop 4, Wynwood. Miami's mural district. Old warehouses painted from
the pavement to the roof. In the game it's called the stockyards. Same
warehouses, same walls of color. From the murals it's a short drive
downtown, to the arena.
